title: Seed afterripening and germination photoinhibition in the genus Crocus (Iridaceae)
why: Abstract opened: 23 Greek Crocus taxa, light response differs among taxa (photoinhibition most common in dry-habitat taxa) and GA3 was tested in a subset; the taxa are not named on the page and the full text is behind a purchase wall, so per-species light/dark and GA3 results are unread.
